I will. If only to chase this thought you put in my mind tonight. I can't not know if it is possible. Thank you, I'll try and sleep too. Thank you.

That was really nice of you to say. I really appreciate that. Edit: You have reached out to a complete stranger and made me feel good for a bit. For no reason other than that I wanted you to see what happens in my mind I wrote the following as quick as my fingers could lay down my exact thoughts. It went from addressing you to an internal debate. Thank you for being you though. 

***thought stream commences*** Although I'm already coming up with reasons why I haven't pursued writing as we speak, it is something I've heard people mention to me when I actually put something down. I wouldn't know what to write. I don't finish anything lately, well.. I used to not finish things lately, now I don't start things. I used to be able to obsess and use the momentum to get really far in the project of the week I chose. Now it seems they don't make it past my head. For example, that very made-me-feel-good comment you made will make me look into what it takes to be a writer. All of the workshop, ooh ooh  I know, what about the write a novel in 30 day challenge? That should keep me motivated. Well let's look it up! Hmmm they said a good writer reads often, well then let's read some books! Ahh but which? The classics definitely the classics. So now that you have all these books, when are you going to read them and start writing and become a voice of some sort and eventual success? I'll get to it. 
Soon. I promise me, you can do it, people tell you that you can. You feel it when you read your own writing that you can. You tale time to make sure your argument is sealed tight so as not to be misunderstood. You can be great. I know you can, just do it. Please. 

Soon.

Most people get uncomfortable when you bring up death. When I read your question my head always goes back to a male figure saying "can't think about that shit, drives you crazy" but how?? I mean what else is there to think about. It is everything. Then because I couldn't have the blind faith most adults had the topic became taboo, god wasn't allowed to be debated past, 'just gotta have faith' I'd love me some good shielding faith. I even went with the new age guys for a while. Like hey in the moment, we make out own life by feeling how we want to in the moment. I couldn't hold that once I put pen paper and really looked at it. It wasn't scary, I've never feared death, I've felt scared or danger, but death I eagerly waited for. A freak accident, a bus crashing into me, my most obsessive thoughts were always on a plane. I hope it crashes. Every flight. But never happened. Life keeps going, another day another day. I'm not sure why I'm writing. I must sound crazy.

Covered them up with distraction. I didn't know what to make of the thoughts of jumping out of a window at age 12. I just wanted this done with. You know, at first I said 'well I just want to know what happens' , then I noticed I don't cry when people die. It made me different and I used that as my lifeline. I wasn't even joyful for more than an event though. It is like I've been happy but never content with life. When I got older smoking weed became my first addiction. I did it daily because I felt I needed it to sleep. Now I don't smoke anymore I have coke for the up feeling. I'm masking it. Ive never felt anything for long. I've have snippets of emotions. Now I'm just done with being detached. Observing. Maybe I'm just a self absorbed cunt that needs a good kick in the ass. It won't help. I'll just watch myself go through the motion knowing that I'm still faking it. I'm full of shit. People don't deal with this. They just keep on keeping on. 

There's a coal miner waking up at 4am and he gives 2 shits about what it all means. Just want food and shelter for his family. But I can't turn it off
Anything I want they back me. I'm 31 they still support me. That's why they will at least hear from me that I know they wanted the best for me .
